title: Pills, circles and rounded cards
summary: border-radius makes pills (999px), circles (50%) and cards, and overflow: hidden clips their insides.
explanation: border-radius: 999px is a trick: any value bigger than half the height gives fully round ends, so the tags stay pills whatever their text length.
50% rounds each corner by half the box's own size, so a square becomes a circle. On a rectangle it would make an ellipse.
The card has rounded corners, but its coloured header would poke out of them without overflow: hidden on the card: rounding the parent does not clip the children.
tryThis: Remove overflow: hidden from .card: the header's square corners show.
Change .avatar's width to 80px (height stays 48px): 50% now makes an ellipse.
Change .tag's radius to 6px: rounded rectangles instead of pills.

children.text: The corners clip the header because the card hides its overflow.
